en.titre:
GLOW UP RULES
EVERY MAN NEEDS.

en.texte: Twice a day, then a simple moisturizer. Clear skin is the easiest glow up there is.
Brush twice a day and floss at night. A clean smile is the first thing people notice.
Easy runs 2 or 3 times a week, no rush. Personally, I follow a plan from a running coach app like Atala.
Cool, dark and quiet room. Better sleep shows on your face the next morning.
Shoulders back, chin level, chest open. Good posture makes any outfit look better.
